Worker08 exact-head reproduction for W08-IR-001 is confirmed at `b90a2fd4681d20e2586481b7b9b1114a78281b94`. Comparing every selected payload against its original beforeimage finds95 new/changed `ontology_mapping.evidence` entries typed MANUAL_CURATION across88 payloads; identical inherited human evidence is excluded. Recorded agent histories do not make those entries human-supplied.

The exact per-entry JSON pointers, assertions, after hashes and last history events are in `C/preflight/w08-final-findings-triage-v1/target-verification-v1.json` (C is the durable all-unmatched campaign root). Use actual source/decision categories claim by claim, preserve source URLs/times/history, and do not globally replace ComponentEvidenceTypeEnum.MANUAL_CURATION or regrade identities. Corrected exact bytes need independent successor review. This comment relates the W08 reproduction here; its other11 findings remain separately routed.

The full frozen-campaign provenance audit is now complete and independently reviewed. It covers 981 proposal before/after pairs (631 new owners, 350 existing-owner edits) at the declared frozen worker heads; later correction heads are not silently substituted. All 3,074 sealed delivery members were rehashed by the coordinator.

The duplicate-aware audit found 698 added or changed complete MappingEvidence objects in 646 proposals that use MANUAL_CURATION: **697 confirmed newly agent-authored entries**, plus one ambiguous historical Casamino wrapper. The claim-specific suggestions are 696 LLM_SUGGESTION entries across 645 proposals and one narrow Neopeptone DATABASE_MATCH entry. Twenty-nine unchanged historical mapping objects and two separate component-evidence additions are excluded from repair. This is a provenance finding, not 697 chemical identity rejections.

Preserve the Casamino historical assertion and agent wrapper as an explicitly unresolved exception: the available history does not establish who originally supplied the old evidence. Preserve all historical human contributions, original notes/citations/timestamps and the separate ComponentEvidenceTypeEnum semantics. A URL or ontology contributor alone is not human review of the MIM assertion. Mapping/source/role/export holds remain.

A future guarded correction must rebind the exact final owner and complete evidence-object bytes after source and shared-owner reconciliation. Correct only individually justified evidence_type fields and append truthful history. Do not replace enums globally or transfer prior whole-owner approvals. W02’s 58 flagged entries were reviewed mechanically and for provenance only; its own scientists do not independently approve their original chemical decisions through this audit.

The independent audit also found two defects in its private artifacts, both repaired before this coordinator publication: SKEPTICAL-PROV-001, a lexical output-containment/overwrite weakness in the initial audit helper, fixed in an immutable v2 with four boundary controls; and SKEPTICAL-PROV-002, a machine-summary label confusing 696 evidence entries with proposal count, corrected to 696 entries across 645 proposals. Original helpers, failed probes, summaries and correction receipts are retained. No escaped write occurred in the recorded run; no atomicity or hostile-concurrency guarantee is claimed. These are resolved audit-process findings, not new production-corpus defects.

Validation: 18 meaningful private audit tests pass; independent raw-pair recomputation and a 991-file byte-identical replay agree; native review validation/rendering pass for all 981 targets. Final skeptical review has no open audit blockers and approves only the read-only audit packet.
